statement: You receive one line holding a balanced string of ( and ) that splits into blocks, each balanced and impossible to split further. Remove the outer pair of every block and print what remains. Track depth: increment on an opener, decrement on a closer. Copy an opening bracket only when the depth after its increment is 2 or more, and a closing bracket only when the depth before its decrement is 2 or more.
constraints: The string contains only ( and ) and is balanced.

example.why: The blocks are (()()) and (()); stripping each outer pair leaves ()() and ().

hint: A bracket belongs to the shell exactly when the counter touches zero on its step.
mistake: Using a stack of characters; with a single bracket type the depth counter is the whole stack.
